'''Open''' is the constructed format for current virtual play: Decipher-printed cards plus the post-2014 Virtual Sets and Defensive Shields. On GEMP this is the environment used for virtual championship events such as the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]].

This is not the same label as [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (no current virtual cards) and is not a closed or limited format.
